class.name: NetwDespawnConfig
class.brief_description: Everything one entity [Script] declares about how a peer removes its nodes.
class.description: The policy is authored on a [Script] and read back for every node that script drives, because [method Netw.configure_despawn] runs from [method Object._init] and the removal happens later, on whichever peer received the DESPAWN frame. [method before_removal] stores only the method name, so the config does not retain a [Node] and can be reused for other instances. Before removal, the peer resolves the method on the node and skips it when absent. An author who declared nothing gets an empty [member hook_method] and a [member linger_seconds] of [code]0.0[/code], which frees immediately, so the defaults are the policy rather than an absence a reader branches on. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_despawn(self) \ .before_removal(_play_death_vfx) \ .linger(0.5) [/codeblock]

method.name: before_removal
method.description: Declares that [param callable]'s method runs on the entity root before the node leaves the tree, for death VFX or for handing children off. Only [method Callable.get_method] is kept, into [member hook_method]. Returns the same config so the declaration chains.

method.name: linger
method.description: Declares [member linger_seconds]. Returns the same config so the declaration chains.

members.member: Method called on the entity root before removal, or empty for none. Declared through [method before_removal], which is the only spelling that keeps the object out of the record.
Seconds the node stays in the tree reporting [constant NetwMultiplayer.ENTITY_STATE_LINGERING] before it is freed. [code]0.0[/code] frees it in the same pass. Declared through [method linger].
